Welcome to the new York County One Map!

Below are two options to consider:

1) If you need an interactive map application, please launch the One Map Viewer from the main menu. Features include pan, zoom, search, print, 100+ layers.


2) If you need a report focused application, to look up a property by address or parcel and find where you vote or elected representatives, use the "Property Search." Find more information in report form by clicking on links - Services/Utilities | Stormwater | Public Safety | Zoning | Political | School Attendance | Oblique/Streetview Imagery


Please use the survey to provide feedback such as suggestions for features or layers.  -York County GIS Team
